01SL company

A limited company (SL)

The usual choice for a business with partners, staff or bigger plans.

  1. 1

    Start from €1

    Since the 2022 Crea y Crece law, an SL can be formed with €1 of capital. Until it reaches €3,000, 20% of profit goes to a legal reserve.

  2. 2

    Or the standard €3,000

    The classic route puts in the full €3,000 at the start.

  3. 3

    Bank, registry and permits

    Business account, company registration and the activity licence you need, handled with you.

02Self-employed

Working as autónomo

The simplest way to work and invoice in your own name.

  1. 1

    €80 a month to start

    New self-employed pay a flat €80 a month in social security for the first 12 months.

  2. 2

    Twelve more months

    If your net income stays below the minimum wage, the flat rate can run for another 12 months.

  3. 3

    Registration and invoices

    We register you with tax and social security and set up invoicing from day one.

03Tax

The Beckham regime

Eligible professionals who move to Spain can pay a flat 24% on income up to €600,000, for six tax years.

Out of every €100 you earn
€24Tax€76Stays with you

Yearly tax at 24%

Before social security. Eligibility depends on your contract and history, and we check it before you move.
